title: Columns of returned SQL rows that MEOS does not state
description: Declared values of the columns of rows a SQL function returns that its wrapper computes rather than reads from MEOS. Consumed by parser/sqlfn.py, which fails generation on any row with a column neither fed by a C value nor declared here.

composites.description: The composite types of another extension a SQL function returns, which the SQL the catalog reads does not create, keyed by type name.

note.description: The extension creating the type, and the functions returning it.

columns.description: The (name, SQL type) of each member, in order.

arrays.description: The layout a wrapper gives the SQL array a function returns beyond the C array, keyed by SQL name.

note.description: What the wrapper lays out, and why MEOS does not state it.

nulls.description: The output array whose true elements are NULL elements of the SQL array.

rowLength.description: The public function, and the parameters of the function it takes, answering the length of each row of a two-dimensional SQL array whose rows the C array lays out one after the other.

inputs.description: The C parameters a wrapper fills from a two-dimensional SQL array it takes, keyed by SQL name.

note.description: What the wrapper reads of the arrays, and why MEOS does not state it.

args.description: Keyed by the position of the argument, from 0.

values.description: The C array of the elements, row by row.

rows.description: The parameter of the number of rows.

columns.description: The parameter of the number of columns.

count.description: The parameter of the number of elements.

nulls.description: The C array true for a NULL element.

nullElement.description: The C value a NULL element passes, where no nulls array is stated.

rows.description: Keyed by the composite type a function returns, or by its SQL name when it returns record.

note.description: What the wrapper computes, and why MEOS does not state it.

from.description: ordinal: the column numbers the rows from 1, as PostgreSQL's WITH ORDINALITY. return, or the name of an out-parameter: the C value feeding the column, where two C values of the column's type leave its source to this statement.

field.description: The field of the struct an array return holds feeding the column. A row naming fields reads those only.

offset.description: A constant the wrapper adds to the C value feeding the column.
